svg.font-family: PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft YaHei, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SRCNN on KV260: experiment evolution
svg.desc: Condensed from 231 registered experiments (results.csv). Only turning points are drawn; every ID links to experiments/<ID>_*/. Numbers are ms/frame; the evidence level is stated on each node.. Generated by evolution_graph.cjs from graph.json; do not edit by hand.
svg.text: Condensed from 231 registered experiments (results.csv). Only turning points are drawn; every ID links to experiments/<ID>_*/. Numbers are ms/frame; the evidence level is stated on each node.

Metric: ms/frame = cycles x clock period. HLS = HLS estimated cycles x target clock; RTL x routed = C/RTL co-simulation cycles x an independently closed post-route clock. No value is a board measurement.

Solid: baseline or parameter evolution, retry after fix, integration of an existing module; dashed: numerical evidence or inspiration, control, verification of the same design, replay. Edges are design lineage, not Git history.

g.title: E000 Original float baseline Measure the untouched golden source before changing anything HLS 19,601 ms BRAM18K 11,064 needed, device has 288: full 23.8 MiB feature maps cannot stay on chip failed or below gate origin
E010 Per-layer range and bit-width scan Scan 16/12/10/8-bit fixed point on all 13 Set14 images (numpy fake-quant) 10-bit: dPSNR -0.0695 dB analysis Sources: E000 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

E017 ap_fixed reference, 10-bit Real ap_fixed loading, layer-boundary rounding and saturation; becomes the bit-exact reference C sim: bit-exact reference analysis Sources: E010 (numerical evidence or inspiration)
E065 Conv2-only 8-bit weights Mixed precision point: only Conv2 weights and bias to signed 8-bit 13 images: dPSNR -0.0759 dB analysis Sources: E017 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

E023 Directives only: pipeline inner loop Keep the structure, add pipelining directives Configuration keys silently ignored by the tool; result identical to E000 invalid configuration Sources: E000 (baseline or parameter evolution)

E029 Directives (valid retry) Generate directives from the schema, reject unknown keys HLS 3,811 ms BRAM18K 11,114: directives alone cannot fix whole-image storage failed or below gate Sources: E023 (retry after fix)

E033 10-bit streaming network, T=32 Line buffers and stream connections remove the full intermediate feature maps HLS 123.5 ms LUT 136,868: narrow multiplications fell into LUTs, only 9 DSP used failed or below gate Sources: E000 (baseline or parameter evolution), E017 (numerical evidence or inspiration), E029 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

E047 Force products onto DSP One change: bind the 251 products per cycle to DSP48 HLS 29.1 ms 251 DSP as planned, but LUT 89,341 exceeds the cap failed or below gate Sources: E033 (baseline or parameter evolution)

E039 Weights in LUTRAM One change: weight storage from BRAM to LUTRAM HLS 29.8 ms, 44,530 LUT First resource-feasible point; HLS timing warning passed with warning Sources: E047 (baseline or parameter evolution)

E043 Fastest point of the sweep One axis per step: T, unroll split, weight storage, clock HLS 6.94 ms HLS timing warning; phase-1 selected point passed with warning Sources: E039 (baseline or parameter evolution)
g.text: One axis per step: T, unroll

g.title: E070 First Vivado route Route the first feasible point at the 10 ns target routed: timing not met WNS -1.277 ns: an unregistered 8-deep DSP cascade. First calibration point: clock 1.5x worse than HLS, LUT 0.46x failed or below gate Sources: E039 (verification of the same design)
g.text: Route the first feasible point at

g.title: P01 Packing PE: two 8-bit products per DSP 27-bit packed multiply, gap 18, signed-low borrow repair PE only: 1 DSP per pair, exact partial experiment, no whole-design metric Sources: E043 (numerical evidence or inspiration)
g.text: PE only: 1 DSP per pair, exact

g.title: P12 Packing in the whole network Pair output channels so one DSP does two multiplications HLS 5.42 ms DSP halved, but decoding and selectors need 292,053 LUT failed or below gate Sources: E043 (baseline or parameter evolution), P01 (integration of an existing module)
g.text: Pair output channels so one DSP

g.title: W01 Winograd PE F(2x2,3x3) Exact integer transforms; inverse divides by 4 exactly PE only: exact partial experiment, no whole-design metric Sources: E043 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

W07 Winograd Conv1 in the network Nine 3x3 pieces of the 9x9 kernel, conditional tile scan HLS 22.9 ms 5.7 M Conv1 cycles: the conditional tile branch is taken at every position passed with warning Sources: E043 (baseline or parameter evolution), W01 (integration of an existing module)

W10 Continuous Winograd Replace the conditional scan with a fixed-tile continuous pipeline HLS 7.55 ms T16 only; the T8 variant W09 needs 135,496 LUT passed with warning Sources: W07 (baseline or parameter evolution)
g.text: ! T16 only; the T8 variant W09

g.title: W18 Winograd with narrow raw-weight bank Keep only the transformed banks the MAC engines read HLS 4.23 ms HLS timing warning; still slower than continuous direct convolution passed with warning Sources: W10 (baseline or parameter evolution)

G03 Scatter with merged edge kernels Replace gather by channel-reduced scatter of partial sums HLS 44.1 ms Slower than the gather control G01 (29.8 ms); direction closed passed with warning Sources: E043 (control)

S01 Intermediate maps in DDR Expose the two scratch arrays through m_axi Global ports were not exported; tool still synthesized on-chip storage invalid configuration Sources: E043 (baseline or parameter evolution)

S03 Output-tile fusion B=8..64 Fuse Conv1/Conv2 per output tile to shrink buffers HLS 130 to 228 ms Recomputed halos cost more cycles than the buffers save failed or below gate Sources: E043 (baseline or parameter evolution)

C11 Winograd + packing combined Stack the two DSP-saving routes HLS 1.08 ms LUT 248,797 / FF 307,525: far over the device; gains do not add failed or below gate Sources: W18 (integration of an existing module), P12 (integration of an existing module)
g.text: over the device; gains do not add

g.title: F08 Continuous direct convolution Separate window generation from MAC engines; one II=1 pixel/fold loop HLS 4.19 ms 7,013 of 13,268 Conv3 LUT are multiplexers for the held window passed with warning Sources: E043 (baseline or parameter evolution)

F13 Rotate the held window Rotate channels instead of dynamic selection HLS 4.19 ms Cycles unchanged; LUT/FF variants F14/F15 exceed budget passed with warning Sources: F08 (baseline or parameter evolution)

F20 Exact IEEE output encoder Build the float output bit pattern directly: 0 DSP, 242 LUT PE only: bit-exact, 0 DSP partial experiment, no whole-design metric Sources: F08 (numerical evidence or inspiration)
g.text: Build the float output bit pattern

g.title: F23 Encoder in the network, 3 ns target Replace only output decoding HLS 2.96 ms Global path 2.822 ns is the Conv1 weight loader's address multiplier passed with warning Sources: F13 (baseline or parameter evolution), F20 (integration of an existing module)

F24 Affine weight-load indexing Remove the multiplier from the load address HLS 2.83 ms Critical path moves to a 2.699 ns flattened-loop counter passed with warning Sources: F23 (baseline or parameter evolution)
F25 LOOP_FLATTEN off in the loader Only one directive changed HLS 2.64 ms HLS timing warning at 2.5 ns passed with warning Sources: F24 (baseline or parameter evolution)

F28 Private parameter banks 46 % of F25 LUT sat outside the dataflow region in weight banks and muxes; one AXI reader streams parameters into per-layer private banks HLS 2.62 ms HLS estimate only; needs RTL and routing passed with warning Sources: F25 (baseline or parameter evolution)

g.title: F81 Implement F25 First place-and-route of the mainline Kernel OOM on the 15 GiB host: Vivado worker processes exceeded memory failed or below gate Sources: F25 (verification of the same design)
g.text: ✗ Kernel OOM on the 15 GiB host:

g.title: F82 RTL co-simulation of F25 Two frames, finite FIFOs, deadlock detection RTL 1,068,183 cycles, bit-exact passed, comparable metric Sources: F25 (verification of the same design)

F92 Implement F25, single-thread retry maxThreads=1 hook; routed at 5 ns, WNS +0.568 RTL x routed 5.34 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: F81 (retry after fix), F82 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

F95 Implement F28 Same flow on the private-bank design; routed at 5 ns RTL x routed 5.30 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: F28 (verification of the same design), F92 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

CAL Route calibration (user decision) W21 HLS clock 2.43 ns vs 4.95 ns routed; routed LUT 0.46 to 0.66x HLS over 18 routes. Gates switch to post-route numbers (docs/0005) analysis of F92/F95/F98 analysis Sources: F92 (numerical evidence or inspiration), F95 (numerical evidence or inspiration)
g.text: W21 HLS clock 2.43 ns vs 4.95 ns

g.title: W19 Winograd T8 + streamed parameters Integrate the F28 parameter stream into the W18 Winograd design HLS 1.75 ms Narrowly misses the HLS LUT gate failed or below gate Sources: W18 (baseline or parameter evolution), F28 (integration of an existing module)

W21 Sub-kernel cache layout One change in the parameter transformer: cache indexed by sub-kernel HLS 1.75 ms Passes HLS gates narrowly; needs RTL and routing passed with warning Sources: W19 (baseline or parameter evolution)
F97 RTL co-simulation of W21 Changed parameters, two frames; windows FIFO stalls 45,974 cycles RTL 558,758 cycles, bit-exact passed, comparable metric Sources: W21 (verification of the same design)

W32 Implement W21 at 4.5 ns Same RTL, Performance_Explore; WNS +0.144 RTL x routed 2.51 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: W21 (verification of the same design), F97 (numerical evidence or inspiration), CAL (numerical evidence or inspiration)

W24 Constant weights in ROM Fix the trained parameters at compile time; no AXI reader RTL x routed 2.49 ms (W33, 4.5 ns), 630 DSP passed, comparable metric Sources: W19 (baseline or parameter evolution)

F47 Window FIFO 2 -> 16 Only the transformed-window FIFO depth, after F97's stall evidence RTL 535,771 cycles (F48) passed, comparable metric Sources: W21 (baseline or parameter evolution), F97 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

C16 Deep windows + FRP folds Combine F47's FIFO basis with W27's free-running pipelines RTL x routed 2.41 ms (C21, 4.5 ns) passed, comparable metric Sources: F47 (baseline or parameter evolution), W24 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

C13 T4 with pre-packed Conv2 Fold T=4; Conv2 uses E065's 8-bit weights packed two per DSP once per frame HLS 1.05 ms, 1,032 DSP HLS LUT 127,966 is over the old 70% HLS gate but inside the routed screen passed with warning Sources: W21 (baseline or parameter evolution), E065 (numerical evidence or inspiration), P01 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

g.title: C18 Implement C13 at 5 ns RTL 300,632 cycles (C14); routed LUT 58,529, WNS +0.047; user asked for this route first RTL x routed 1.50 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: C13 (verification of the same design)

C17 C13 + 32-entry window FIFO Only the FIFO depth, reusing F47's evidence at T4 HLS 1.05 ms HLS estimate; RTL and routing needed passed with warning Sources: C13 (baseline or parameter evolution), F47 (numerical evidence or inspiration)
g.text: Only the FIFO depth, reusing F47's

g.title: C22 Implement C17 at 5 ns RTL 273,023 cycles (C20); routed at 5.0 ns, WNS +0.013 RTL x routed 1.365 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: C17 (verification of the same design), C18 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

W36 Implement C17 at 4.5 ns Same RTL, tighter clock Setup fails: WNS -0.216 ns, worst paths are Winograd arithmetic with 8 to 11 logic levels failed or below gate Sources: C17 (verification of the same design), C22 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

C23 Gated parameter reload Load parameters once, reuse across frames HLS 1.05 ms RTL (C27) showed a 4-byte parameter read on a call that should skip loading passed with warning Sources: C13 (baseline or parameter evolution)
g.text: parameter read on a call that

g.title: C28 Reload guard fix Stop HLS from hoisting a scalarized bias read RTL (C31): four calls exact, zero skipped-call AXI passed, comparable metric Sources: C23 (retry after fix)

C32 C17 + guarded reload Transplant only the reload interface into C17 RTL 273,025 cycles (C35) Implementation C36 fails 5 ns setup: WNS -0.102 failed or below gate Sources: C17 (baseline or parameter evolution), C28 (integration of an existing module)

C37 Registered parameter packet Add one 224-bit register stage between parameter FIFO and banks RTL 273,025 cycles (C39) Implementation C40 at 4.5 ns fails: WNS -0.278 failed or below gate Sources: C32 (baseline or parameter evolution)

C38 Balanced registered adder tree Four registered fabric-add levels in the Winograd fold HLS FF 248,672 exceeds the 230 k screen; stopped before RTL failed or below gate Sources: C32 (baseline or parameter evolution)
WSI System integration and board test Wrap the verified C22 IP with DDR and driver; measure end-to-end on the KV260 planned, not run Sources: C22 (baseline or parameter evolution)
g.text: Wrap the verified C22 IP with DDR
